project.name: SIPS Aggregator
project.description:
Builds every SIPS module in dependency order with a single command.
Copy this file as pom.xml into a directory holding clones of all six repositories, then run: mvn install
This is an aggregator only, not a parent: the modules deliberately do NOT inherit from it, so each repository still builds standalone with its own pom.xml. The module list below is the authoritative build order.
